description: Saves a search so that new matches are emailed to the account holder. Inputs: query (required), name, filters (itemTypes such as "grant" or "procurement", sourceTypes such as "federal", geography as US state codes, and SAM.gov fields under sourceContext), cadence and hidelow (whether low-confidence matches are left out). Returns the saved search with its alert settings, or the account's limit and current count when no slot is left. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Does not count toward the search allowance.

cadence.description: Alert email frequency: "daily", "weekly" (default) or "never" to save without email. Whether "daily" is available depends on the account.

filters.description: Filters to narrow alert results. All optional. When omitted, all opportunity types are included.

applicantTypes.description: Eligible applicant type. About 7% of opportunities carry this data, so the filter is soft: opportunities without eligibility data are included.

geography.description: US state codes (2-letter uppercase, e.g. ["CA", "TX"]). Matches opportunities tagged for these states, national opportunities, and opportunities with no stated geography (typically federal). Opportunities tagged only for other states are excluded.

itemTypes.description: Opportunity types. "grant" includes fellowships/scholarships/SBIR. "procurement" includes contracts/RFPs. "financial" includes loans/tax credits.

organization.description: Agency or organization name to match (e.g. "Department of Energy", "NSF", "NIH").

sourceContext.description: Source-specific filters for SAM.gov or Grants.gov, in the terms that source uses.

filters.description: Source-specific filter keys. For SAM.gov: samDepartment, samSubTier, samOffice, samSetAside, samSetAsideCode, samPopState, samPopCity, samPopZip, naics (comma-separated NAICS codes). For Grants.gov: grantsAgencyCode, grantsCfda, grantsDocType.

sourceTypes.description: Funding source type. "federal" = grants.gov, SAM.gov, DOE, NSF, etc.

sources.description: Specific data sources by slug (e.g. ["sam.gov", "grants.gov", "nsf"]). Limits alerts to these sources only.

status.description: Status filter, for example ["open", "rolling"]; "coming_soon" adds opportunities that have not opened yet.

hidelow.description: Whether low-confidence results are hidden in alerts. Default: false

name.description: Friendly name for this search (e.g. "DOE Clean Energy Grants")

query.description: Query to save (e.g. "clean energy research grants", "IT services federal contracts").

name: save_search
title: Save Search
